blocks.zh: 第七章：委外活動
blocks.en: Chapter 7: Outsourced Activities

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 GDP 委外活動 (outsourced activities) 的法規框架 — 委外不等於免責，委託方 (Contract Giver) 仍是最終責任人
blocks.en: Understand the regulatory framework for GDP outsourced activities: outsourcing does not transfer accountability, and the Contract Giver remains ultimately responsible

blocks.zh: 區分 Contract Giver（委託方）與 Contract Acceptor（受託方）各自的職責邊界與義務
blocks.en: Distinguish the responsibilities and obligations of the Contract Giver and the Contract Acceptor

blocks.zh: 掌握委外前、委外中的稽核要求 — 包含風險導向的稽核頻率設計邏輯
blocks.en: Master the audit requirements before and during outsourcing, including the logic for designing a risk-based audit frequency

blocks.zh: 了解轉包 (sub-contracting) 的控制要求：受託方不得未經批准擅自轉包
blocks.en: Understand the controls on sub-contracting: the Contract Acceptor must not sub-contract without approval

blocks.zh: 應用至台灣 CDMO 情境：辨識哪些物流、倉儲、檢驗活動屬於 GDP 委外範疇，以及如何建立合約管理體系
blocks.en: Apply this to the Taiwan CDMO setting: identify which logistics, warehousing and testing activities fall within GDP outsourcing, and how to build a contract management system

blocks.zh: 7.1 Principle — 原則
blocks.en: 7.1 Principle

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：委外活動的三個管控要素
blocks.en: Core Concept: Three Control Elements of Outsourced Activities

blocks.zh: 本節揭示委外活動合規的三個必要條件：
blocks.en: This section sets out three necessary conditions for compliant outsourcing:

blocks.zh: Correctly Defined（正確定義）： 委外的活動範圍必須明確描述，不能有模糊地帶。例如「冷鏈運輸」不夠具體，應定義為「2–8°C 溫控運輸，從 A 廠交貨點至 B 客戶倉庫，含溫度記錄與交接確認」。
blocks.en: Correctly Defined: The scope of the outsourced activity must be described clearly, leaving no gray areas. For example, "cold chain transport" is not specific enough; define it as "2–8°C temperature-controlled transport from the delivery point at Site A to the warehouse of Customer B, including temperature records and handover confirmation".

blocks.zh: Agreed（書面同意）： Must have a written contract — 這是強制性用語 (must)，不是建議 (should)。口頭協議在 GDP 查廠中不被接受。
blocks.en: Agreed: There must be a written contract. This is mandatory wording (must), not a recommendation (should). A verbal agreement is not accepted in a GDP inspection.

blocks.zh: Controlled（持續管控）： 委外不是簽完合約就結束，必須有持續的監督機制（稽核、KPI 監控、偏差回報）。
blocks.en: Controlled: Outsourcing does not end when the contract is signed. There must be ongoing oversight mechanisms (audits, KPI monitoring, deviation reporting).

blocks.zh: 關鍵邏輯：委外是責任的「委託執行」，不是責任的「轉移」。
blocks.en: Key logic: outsourcing is the "delegated performance" of responsibility, not the "transfer" of responsibility.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你把珍貴的藝術品委託給搬運公司運送。你是委託方，搬運公司是受託方。你不能說「交給他們了，萬一摔壞與我無關」。法律上，你有責任確認搬運公司有足夠的設備與訓練，且合約已清楚規定包裝要求、溫濕度限制、保險責任等。GDP 委外管理就是這個邏輯 — 藥品（比藝術品更不容有失）的委外必須更嚴謹。
blocks.en: Imagine you entrust a valuable artwork to a moving company. You are the contract giver and the moving company is the contract acceptor. You cannot say, "I handed it over to them, so if it breaks it has nothing to do with me." Legally, you are responsible for confirming that the moving company has adequate equipment and training, and that the contract clearly specifies packaging requirements, temperature and humidity limits, insurance liability and so on. GDP outsourcing management follows the same logic. Medicines, which tolerate failure even less than artwork, demand an even more rigorous approach to outsourcing.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Note
blocks.en: Key Note

blocks.zh: 「Must」vs.「Should」的法規意涵： 本節用 "There must be a written Contract"。在 GDP/GMP 文件中，must 代表絕對要求，should 代表強烈建議但有彈性。書面合約是 GDP 委外的絕對前提，缺少合約即屬重大缺失 (major deficiency)。
blocks.en: Regulatory implication of "Must" vs. "Should": This section says "There must be a written Contract". In GDP/GMP documents, must means an absolute requirement, while should means a strong recommendation with some flexibility. A written contract is an absolute prerequisite for GDP outsourcing, and the absence of one is a major deficiency.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 委託一家物流公司配送冷藏藥品，但雙方只有口頭約定。在 GDP 查廠時，稽查員會如何評定這個情況？
blocks.en: Your CDMO has engaged a logistics company to distribute refrigerated medicines, but the two parties have only a verbal agreement. How would an inspector classify this situation in a GDP inspection?

blocks.zh: 「避免誤解以保護產品完整性」— 在合約中，哪三個條款是最容易產生誤解、也最關鍵的？
blocks.en: "Avoid misunderstandings that may result in a product of unsatisfactory quality": which three contract clauses are the most prone to misunderstanding and the most critical?

blocks.zh: 7.2 Contract Giver — 委託方
blocks.en: 7.2 Contract Giver

blocks.zh: 核心概念：委託方的三層責任
blocks.en: Core Concept: Three Layers of Responsibility for the Contract Giver

blocks.zh: 7.2.1 最終責任不可外包： 即使活動由受託方執行，委託方仍是最終責任人。這是 GDP 委外管理的核心邏輯。對 CDMO 而言，若你委託第三方倉庫存放客戶的藥品，倉庫發生溫度偏差，你作為 Contract Giver 仍需對客戶負責。
blocks.en: 7.2.1 Ultimate responsibility cannot be outsourced: Even when the activity is performed by the Contract Acceptor, the Contract Giver remains ultimately responsible. This is the core logic of GDP outsourcing management. For a CDMO, if you engage a third-party warehouse to store a customer's medicines and a temperature deviation occurs there, you as the Contract Giver are still answerable to the customer.

blocks.zh: 7.2.2 稽核義務的三個時間點：
blocks.en: 7.2.2 Three points in time for audits:

blocks.zh: 委外前 (Before commencement)： 資格稽核，確認受託方具備能力
blocks.en: Before commencement: A qualification audit to confirm the Contract Acceptor is capable

blocks.zh: 有變更時 (Whenever there has been a change)： 例如受託方搬遷、更換設備、人事異動
blocks.en: Whenever there has been a change: For example, the Contract Acceptor relocates, changes equipment or has personnel changes

blocks.zh: 定期稽核 (Risk-based frequency)： 頻率依活動風險定義，不是固定一年一次
blocks.en: Periodic audits (risk-based frequency): The frequency is defined according to the risk of the activity; it is not a fixed once a year

blocks.zh: 7.2.3 資訊充分提供： 委託方有義務提供足夠的產品資訊給受託方，包含溫度要求、特殊搬運注意事項、產品危害性等。資訊不足導致的問題，委託方難辭其咎。
blocks.en: 7.2.3 Provision of sufficient information: The Contract Giver is obliged to provide the Contract Acceptor with sufficient product information, including temperature requirements, special handling precautions and product hazards. If problems arise from insufficient information, the Contract Giver cannot escape blame.

blocks.zh: 想像你雇用一名保母照顧小孩。你（委託方）不能說「我雇了保母，小孩出事與我無關」。你有責任：(1) 確認保母有資格（事前稽核）；(2) 告訴保母孩子的過敏史、作息習慣（充分資訊提供）；(3) 不定期回家確認情況（可隨時稽核）。GDP 委外管理的邏輯完全相同，只是保護的對象從孩子換成了藥品。
blocks.en: Imagine you hire a nanny to look after your child. You (the contract giver) cannot say, "I hired a nanny, so if something happens to the child it has nothing to do with me." You are responsible for: (1) confirming the nanny is qualified (pre-engagement audit); (2) telling the nanny about the child's allergies and routines (providing sufficient information); (3) coming home unannounced from time to time to check on things (audits at any time). The logic of GDP outsourcing management is exactly the same; only the thing being protected changes from a child to a medicine.

blocks.zh: 風險導向的稽核頻率設計： 文件說頻率應「based on risk」，這意味著你需要建立一個供應商風險評分系統。高風險受託方（如冷鏈物流、處理麻藥的倉庫）應比低風險受託方（如辦公室清潔服務）更頻繁接受稽核。建議在 Supplier Qualification SOP 中明確定義風險分級與對應稽核頻率（例如：高風險 = 每年一次現場稽核，中風險 = 每兩年一次，低風險 = 問卷自評）。
blocks.en: Designing a risk-based audit frequency: The document says the frequency should be "based on risk", which means you need a supplier risk scoring system. High-risk Contract Acceptors (such as cold chain logistics or a warehouse handling narcotics) should be audited more often than low-risk ones (such as an office cleaning service). It is advisable to define the risk categories and the corresponding audit frequencies explicitly in the Supplier Qualification SOP (for example: high risk = on-site audit every year, medium risk = every two years, low risk = self-assessment questionnaire).

blocks.zh: 「Audits should be permitted at any time」： 這句話應寫入合約條款。受託方必須在合約中同意接受委託方的不定期稽核，否則合約本身即不符 GDP 要求。
blocks.en: "Audits should be permitted at any time": This sentence should be written into the contract terms. The Contract Acceptor must agree in the contract to accept unannounced audits by the Contract Giver; otherwise the contract itself does not meet GDP requirements.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 正在評估一家新的冷鏈物流商（2–8°C）承接客戶藥品的國內配送。根據 7.2 的要求，你需要在正式委外前完成以下工作：
blocks.en: Your CDMO is evaluating a new cold chain logistics provider (2–8°C) to undertake domestic distribution of customers' medicines. Under the requirements of 7.2, you need to complete the following before formally outsourcing:

blocks.zh: 供應商資格評估問卷： 確認對方有 GDP 合規的設備、SOP、人員訓練記錄
blocks.en: Supplier qualification questionnaire: Confirm the provider has GDP-compliant equipment, SOPs and personnel training records

blocks.zh: 現場稽核： 重點查核冷藏車輛的溫控設備與校正記錄、駕駛訓練、偏差處理 SOP
blocks.en: On-site audit: Focus on the temperature control equipment and calibration records of the refrigerated vehicles, driver training and the deviation handling SOP

blocks.zh: 合約草擬： 必須包含允許不定期稽核的條款、溫度偏差回報時限（建議 24 小時內）、資訊保密義務
blocks.en: Contract drafting: It must include a clause permitting unannounced audits, a time limit for reporting temperature deviations (24 hours is recommended) and confidentiality obligations

blocks.zh: 產品技術資料傳遞： 提供藥品的儲存要求、緊急聯絡人、客戶交貨地址清單
blocks.en: Transfer of product technical information: Provide the medicines' storage requirements, emergency contacts and a list of customer delivery addresses

blocks.zh: 你的受託物流商因業務擴展，將倉庫從台北搬至桃園。這算是「有變更」嗎？你需要在搬遷後進行重新稽核嗎？
blocks.en: Your contracted logistics provider is expanding its business and moves its warehouse from Taipei to Taoyuan. Does this count as "a change"? Do you need to re-audit after the move?

blocks.zh: 若你委外的冷鏈物流商有 GDP 認證，你是否可以免除稽核義務？理由為何？
blocks.en: If the cold chain logistics provider you outsource to holds GDP certification, are you exempt from your audit obligation? Why or why not?

blocks.zh: 委託方提供的「所有必要資訊」，對無菌注射劑產品而言具體應包含哪些文件或資料？
blocks.en: For a sterile injectable product, what specific documents or data should the "all necessary information" provided by the Contract Giver include?

blocks.zh: 7.3 Contract Acceptor — 受託方
blocks.en: 7.3 Contract Acceptor

blocks.zh: 核心概念：受託方的五項義務
blocks.en: Core Concept: Five Obligations of the Contract Acceptor

blocks.zh: 7.3.1 執行責任： 受託方對其執行的 GDP 活動負責，這與委託方的最終責任並行存在，不是替代關係。雙方各自的責任在合約中必須清楚區分。
blocks.en: 7.3.1 Responsibility for performance: The Contract Acceptor is responsible for the GDP activities it performs. This exists alongside the Contract Giver's ultimate responsibility and does not replace it. The responsibilities of each party must be clearly distinguished in the contract.

blocks.zh: 7.3.2 能力要求（四要素）：
blocks.en: 7.3.2 Capability requirements (four elements):

blocks.zh: Premises and equipment（廠房設備）：合適的倉儲條件、運輸設備
blocks.en: Premises and equipment: suitable storage conditions and transport equipment

blocks.zh: Procedures（程序）：完善的 SOP
blocks.en: Procedures: well-established SOPs

blocks.zh: Knowledge and experience（知識與經驗）：了解藥品配送的特殊要求
blocks.en: Knowledge and experience: understanding of the special requirements of medicine distribution

blocks.zh: Competent personnel（稱職人員）：經過訓練且有記錄
blocks.en: Competent personnel: trained, with records

blocks.zh: 7.3.3 禁止未授權轉包： 受託方不得擅自將工作轉包給第三方。必須先取得委託方的事前核准，且委託方（或受託方）需對第三方完成稽核。資訊流通的義務（批發配送資訊）必須延伸到整條委外鏈。
blocks.en: 7.3.3 Unauthorized sub-contracting is prohibited: The Contract Acceptor must not sub-contract work to a third party on its own initiative. It must first obtain the Contract Giver's prior approval, and the Contract Giver (or the Contract Acceptor) must audit the third party. The obligation to pass on information (wholesale distribution information) must extend through the entire outsourcing chain.

blocks.zh: 7.3.5 資訊回報義務（must）： 受託方必須主動將可能影響產品品質的資訊回報給委託方，包含溫度偏差、搬運損壞、可疑假藥等。
blocks.en: 7.3.5 Obligation to report information (must): The Contract Acceptor must proactively report to the Contract Giver any information that may affect product quality, including temperature deviations, handling damage and suspected falsified medicines.

blocks.zh: 受託方就像工程的分包商。如果建商（委託方）把某棟大樓的防水工程交給防水公司（受託方），防水公司不能未告知建商就再把工程轉給另一家不知名小廠（未授權轉包）。若施工中發現牆壁有裂縫（影響品質的資訊），防水公司有義務立即回報建商，而不是自行判斷或隱瞞。GDP 委外中，「資訊對稱」是品質管理的基礎。
blocks.en: The Contract Acceptor is like a sub-contractor on a construction project. If the developer (contract giver) hands the waterproofing of a building to a waterproofing company (contract acceptor), that company cannot pass the work on to an unknown small firm without telling the developer (unauthorized sub-contracting). If cracks are found in a wall during construction (information affecting quality), the waterproofing company is obliged to report them to the developer immediately, rather than judging for itself or concealing them. In GDP outsourcing, "information symmetry" is the foundation of quality management.

blocks.zh: 轉包鏈的資訊流通要求： 7.3.3 特別強調，若受託方轉包給第三方，「wholesale distribution information must be made available in the same way」— 這意味著批次追蹤、溫度記錄、交接文件的完整性，必須在整條轉包鏈中保持一致。實務上建議在合約中明確要求受託方提供完整的轉包鏈資訊揭露，並在供應商管理 SOP 中建立核准程序。
blocks.en: Information flow requirements across the sub-contracting chain: 7.3.3 specifically stresses that if the Contract Acceptor sub-contracts to a third party, "wholesale distribution information must be made available in the same way". This means the completeness of batch tracing, temperature records and handover documentation must be consistent across the entire sub-contracting chain. In practice, it is advisable to require the Contract Acceptor in the contract to disclose complete information on the sub-contracting chain, and to establish an approval procedure in the supplier management SOP.

blocks.zh: 受託方的主動義務 vs. 被動執行： 7.3.4 和 7.3.5 合在一起看，受託方不只是「被動執行指令」，還必須「主動避免有害行為」且「主動回報問題」。這是受託方的積極合規義務。
blocks.en: Proactive obligations vs. passive execution of the Contract Acceptor: Read 7.3.4 and 7.3.5 together: the Contract Acceptor does not merely "passively carry out instructions"; it must also "proactively avoid any activity that may adversely affect quality" and "proactively report problems". These are the Contract Acceptor's active compliance obligations.

blocks.zh: 情境：你的 CDMO 是受託方，為某國際藥廠（委託方）提供成品倉儲服務。某天，你的倉庫因冷氣故障導致一批 2–8°C 產品在 30 分鐘內上升至 12°C。
blocks.en: Scenario: Your CDMO is the Contract Acceptor, providing finished product warehousing for an international pharmaceutical company (the Contract Giver). One day, an air conditioning failure in your warehouse causes a batch of 2–8°C product to rise to 12°C within 30 minutes.

blocks.zh: 根據 7.3 的要求，你的義務是：
blocks.en: Under the requirements of 7.3, your obligations are:

blocks.zh: 立即啟動溫度偏差 SOP： 記錄偏差的時間、最高溫度、影響批次
blocks.en: Immediately start the temperature deviation SOP: Record the time of the deviation, the maximum temperature and the affected batches

blocks.zh: 立即通報委託方（7.3.5）： 不能等到調查完成才通報。「可能影響產品品質的資訊」必須即時回報
blocks.en: Immediately notify the Contract Giver (7.3.5): Do not wait until the investigation is complete. "Information that may affect product quality" must be reported promptly

blocks.zh: 不得擅自處置產品： 在委託方做出品質評估決定前，不得放行、銷毀或繼續使用受影響批次
blocks.en: Do not dispose of the product on your own: Until the Contract Giver makes a quality assessment decision, do not release, destroy or continue to use the affected batches

blocks.zh: 完成 CAPA： 調查根本原因並提出改善措施，提交給委託方審核
blocks.en: Complete the CAPA: Investigate the root cause and propose corrective measures, and submit them to the Contract Giver for review

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 作為受託方，因業務繁忙，私下找了一家合作倉庫代為存放委託方的部分藥品。這違反了哪條 GDP 要求？委託方可以採取什麼措施？
blocks.en: Your CDMO, as Contract Acceptor, is busy and privately engages a partner warehouse to store some of the Contract Giver's medicines. Which GDP requirement does this violate? What measures can the Contract Giver take?

blocks.zh: 合約中應如何具體規定「資訊回報」的時限與格式，以確保 7.3.5 在實務中能有效執行？
blocks.en: How should the contract specify the time limit and format of "information reporting" so that 7.3.5 can be implemented effectively in practice?

blocks.zh: 若委託方要求的操作方式（如包裝方式）實際上可能對產品品質有害，受託方應如何依 7.3.4 處理這種情況？
blocks.en: If the way of working required by the Contract Giver (such as the packaging method) could actually be detrimental to product quality, how should the Contract Acceptor handle this under 7.3.4?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 委外不免責： Contract Giver（委託方）對所有委外的 GDP 活動仍負有最終責任，書面合約是絕對要求（must）
blocks.en: Outsourcing does not remove accountability: The Contract Giver remains ultimately responsible for all outsourced GDP activities, and a written contract is an absolute requirement (must)

blocks.zh: 稽核三時機： 委外前、有重大變更時、依風險定義的定期稽核 — 且必須允許不定期稽核
blocks.en: Three audit occasions: Before outsourcing, when there is a significant change, and periodically at a risk-defined frequency, with unannounced audits always permitted

blocks.zh: 資訊對稱義務： 委託方須提供充分產品資訊；受託方須主動回報任何可能影響品質的資訊
blocks.en: Obligation of information symmetry: The Contract Giver must provide sufficient product information; the Contract Acceptor must proactively report any information that may affect quality

blocks.zh: 轉包管控： 受託方不得未經委託方事前核准（含稽核）擅自轉包；轉包鏈的配送資訊流通義務必須等同原委託鏈
blocks.en: Sub-contracting control: The Contract Acceptor must not sub-contract without the Contract Giver's prior approval (including an audit); the obligation to pass on distribution information along the sub-contracting chain must be equivalent to that of the original contracting chain

blocks.zh: 受託方主動義務： 除被動執行指令外，受託方還有積極義務 — 避免任何可能損害產品品質的行為
blocks.en: Proactive obligations of the Contract Acceptor: Beyond passively carrying out instructions, the Contract Acceptor has an active obligation to avoid any activity that may adversely affect product quality

blocks.zh: CDMO 雙重角色： CDMO 可能同時是委託方（委外物流）和受託方（接受藥廠委外生產），需從兩個視角審視合規義務
blocks.en: The CDMO's dual role: A CDMO may be both a Contract Giver (outsourcing logistics) and a Contract Acceptor (accepting outsourced manufacturing from pharmaceutical companies), so compliance obligations must be examined from both perspectives
